options.label: Sequential
options.note: One order goes to one picker. Simplest for small orders.

options.label: Weighted priority
options.note: Orders are ranked by size, urgency and destination.

options.label: Staged parallel
options.note: Orders are pre-sorted into bins, then picked in parallel.

options.label: As given
options.note: Orders are picked in the order they arrive.

options.label: Flat priority
options.note: All orders have the same priority.

options.label: Late arrivals join
options.note: New orders can join a batch already in progress.

options.label: Parent first
options.note: A parent order must finish before its child orders start.

options.label: Outers only
options.note: Pick whole outer units. Inners and eaches are never broken out.

options.label: Strict
options.note: Pick exactly the unit of measure each order line declares.

options.label: Flexible
options.note: Mix outers, inners and eaches, preferring the larger unit.

options.label: Soft
options.note: Picking can start on soft-reserved stock.

options.label: Hard
options.note: Wait for confirmed stock. Orders are never partly filled.

options.label: Hard, partial allowed
options.note: Wait for confirmed stock, but allow a partial fill when stock is pending.

options.label: Pack after picking
options.note: Items are picked loose and packed later.

options.label: Pack while picking
options.note: Items are packed straight into the box at the station.

options.label: Box required per order
options.note: An order can’t be allocated until it has a packing box.

options.label: Re-plan first
options.note: Try to re-plan the order before short-picking it.

options.label: Short-pick immediately
options.note: Short-pick the line as soon as stock runs out.

fields.label: Allow partial picks
fields.description: A line can be short-picked instead of picked in full.

fields.label: Single-UoM picking
fields.description: Extends multi-order picking (MSIO) to single units. Needs MSIO and UoM picking.

fields.label: Group single-line orders
fields.description: Multi-quantity, single-line orders share a bin (SLOP).

fields.label: Split large orders
fields.description: Large orders are broken up across bins as they stream in.

options.label: Manual
options.note: The picker directs the order through the station.

options.label: Automatic
options.note: The system routes the order through the bins.

options.label: Tier priority
options.note: Prefer racks by weighted tier levels.

options.label: Balanced
options.note: Spread work evenly across back racks.

options.label: Any available
options.note: Use whichever back rack is free.

options.label: Automatic scan
options.note: A barcode scan confirms the pick. No extra step.

options.label: Scan each container
options.note: The picker confirms every container.

options.label: Scan, partial allowed
options.note: The picker can confirm part of a container.

options.label: Scan, last one optional
options.note: The final container scan can be skipped once complete.

options.label: Skip to next order
options.note: Move on automatically, without confirmation.

options.label: Wait for an operator
options.note: The station pauses until an operator resolves it.

options.label: Quarantine the bin
options.note: The problem bin leaves the flow for later.

fields.label: Pick from opened cases
fields.description: Items can be picked from a case that was opened earlier.

fields.label: Confirm empty slots
fields.description: After the last item, the operator confirms the slot is empty.

fields.label: Low-stock count check
fields.description: The operator confirms the quantity when stock falls below its threshold.

options.label: Standard
options.note: One item goes to one bin at a time.

options.label: Parallel
options.note: Several items and orders go to several bins at once.

options.label: Manual (IMTU)
options.note: The picker docks the item carrier by hand.

options.label: Automatic (IMTU)
options.note: The conveyor positions the carrier for docking.

options.label: Multi-unit (MRLI)
options.note: Several items are released and docked together.

options.label: By the RDC
options.note: The robotic dispensing centre handles docking.

options.label: Running bin
options.note: Items are packed into the bin as they arrive.

options.label: Order by order
options.note: Each order is filled completely before the next.

options.label: By opportunity
options.note: Items go into any available slot.

options.label: When the list is scanned
options.note: The rack leaves as soon as its pick list is complete.

options.label: When the picker confirms
options.note: The picker presses a button to release the rack.

options.label: After a timer
options.note: The rack leaves automatically after a set time.

options.label: Stop at capacity
options.note: Picking into a bin stops when it’s full.

options.label: Allow large orders
options.note: Oversized orders may exceed bin capacity.

options.label: Ignore on last item
options.note: The final item can go in even if the bin is full.

options.label: All bins
options.note: Every bin can be marked full.

options.label: Multi-order bins only
options.note: Only multi-order (MSIO) bins can be marked full.

options.label: Early
options.note: Bins are released as soon as possible.

options.label: Late
options.note: Bins are held and released late. Tote flows only.

options.label: Shuffle as needed
options.note: The system reassigns bins to keep work flowing.

options.label: Fixed map
options.note: Each logical bin always maps to the same physical bin.

options.label: Off
options.note: The back operator clears bins in sequence only.

options.label: Complete orders only
options.note: A bin can be released early once its order lines are complete.

options.label: Incomplete allowed
options.note: A bin can be released early even with lines still open.

options.label: Off
options.note: Bins are not grouped.

options.label: Round robin
options.note: Back-station work is split evenly across operators.

options.label: Default strategy
options.note: The station’s standard bin selection is used.

fields.label: Use bin volume
fields.description: Bin volume is considered when allocating multi-order, grouped and split orders.

fields.label: Show bin age
fields.description: Put-to-light colour warns, then escalates, as an order waits.

fields.label: One-press confirmation
fields.description: A single put-to-light (PPTL) button replaces scan and quantity entry. Not for serialized items.

fields.label: Validate box labels (LPN)
fields.description: The box barcode must be scanned before items go in.

fields.label: Show the next item early
fields.description: The next task appears before the rack arrives.

fields.label: Reuse totes immediately
fields.description: A tote is freed for new work as soon as its task completes.

fields.label: Prompt to remove empty totes
fields.description: The operator is asked to take an emptied tote off the station.

fields.label: Allow carrier change
fields.description: The front operator can swap the carrier linked to a bin.

options.label: Front
options.note: Bins leave from the front.

options.label: Back
options.note: Bins leave from the back.

options.label: Either
options.note: Bins can leave from either side.

options.label: Automatic
options.note: The system clears the bin.

options.label: By the operator
options.note: The operator clears the bin.

options.label: From the picking side
options.note: The bin is released from the side it was picked on.

options.label: None
options.note: No label press is required.

options.label: One master label
options.note: A single label covers the whole bin.

options.label: One per layer
options.note: Each layer or section gets its own label.

options.label: Colour-coded
options.note: Labels are colour-coded.

options.label: Don’t print
options.note: Bins ship without a printed label.

options.label: Print on release
options.note: The label prints when the bin leaves the station.

options.label: Print and hold
options.note: The label is held until the operator confirms departure.

fields.label: Confirm zero counts
fields.description: The operator confirms when a count comes out at zero.

fields.label: Confirm zero per rack
fields.description: Zero confirmation is raised for the whole rack (MSU), not each bin.

fields.label: Confirm counted quantity
fields.description: The operator confirms each counted quantity.

fields.label: Count check per rack
fields.description: The count check is raised for the whole rack (MSU), not each bin.
